title: 640. Design Compressed String Iterator

examples.explanation: Letters expand to L,e,e,t,C,o,d,e; queries consume them in order.
After three x values the stream is empty, so next gives an empty string.
Ten copies remain; one next still leaves more.

hints: Parse letter-plus-count runs once into queues.
Keep a pointer plus remaining count for the current run.
next emits the current letter or an empty string when empty; hasNext emits true/false strings.
Adaptation: implement runCompressedIterator(compressed, operations) returning one string per operation.
